phases.name: Wood
phases.description: Growth and life. Healing, nature, poison/blight, and lightning. Fed by Water, feeds Fire; parts Earth, is cut by Metal.

phases.name: Fire
phases.description: Heat and combustion. Fed by Wood, feeds Earth (ash); melts Metal, is quenched by Water.

phases.name: Earth
phases.description: Stone and stability. Rooting, paralysis, grounded vigor. Fed by Fire, feeds Metal; dams Water, is parted by Wood.

phases.name: Metal
phases.description: Edge and force. Blades, blunt force, conduction, hardened armor. Fed by Earth, feeds Water; cuts Wood, is melted by Fire.

phases.name: Water
phases.description: Cold and flow. Frost, fluids, flowing energy. Fed by Metal, feeds Wood; quenches Fire, is dammed by Earth.

cycles.name: Generating
cycles.description: The productive cycle: each phase nourishes the next. When an effect meets its child phase, the child is amplified (lay down Wood, then Fire burns hotter). 'from' is the mother (actor), 'to' is the strengthened child (recipient).

cycles.name: Overcoming
cycles.description: The controlling cycle: each phase restrains another. The controlling effect suppresses (and at sufficient strength dispels) the controlled one — Water quenches Fire, Fire melts Metal. 'from' is the controller (actor), 'to' is the suppressed phase (recipient).

cycles.name: Weakening
cycles.description: The exhaustion cycle (reverse of generating): a child drawn upon saps its mother. The child effect drains the mother it meets, reducing it. The child (actor) drains the mother (recipient); the edges are generating's, read backwards.

cycles.name: Insulting
cycles.description: The rebellion cycle (reverse of overcoming): when the normally-controlled phase is overwhelming, it turns on its controller. An over-strong Fire insults the Water that should quench it, backlashing onto the controller. The rebelling phase (actor) backlashes onto its would-be controller (recipient); the edges are overcoming's, read backwards. Fires only when the actor's magnitude is greater; otherwise overcoming fires on the same pair, suppressing the actor.
